data.text:
LOOK: Groups protest outside the AFP headquarters at Camp Aguinaldo, Quezon City on Friday, April 24, to condemn the Negros Occidental anti-insurgency operation that killed 19 individuals, including UP student Alyssa Alano and local journalist RJ Ledesma.

The AFP has maintained that the operation did not violate human rights and humanitarian law.

However, the New People's Army has said, while a small squad of revolutionary fighters were among those killed, the rest were civilians and human rights advocates. | @jasonsigalesINQ 

READ MORE: https://t.co/TRiR6enbsF
